# Florence Hinder

> Personal site of Florence Hinder: optimist, entrepreneur and engineer based in
> London. She writes Practical Optimism, a blog on practical optimism, technology
> and other musings, published on Substack.

## Who she is

- Deployment Strategist at Encord (https://encord.com)
- Cofounder of Flexsta (https://flexsta.com)
- Builder of many projects across different domains — write-ups are on the blog

## Writing

The blog lives at https://florencehinder.substack.com (publication: Practical Optimism).

Selected posts:

- My Thoughts on Commitment: https://florencehinder.substack.com/p/my-thoughts-on-commitment

- I decided to stop working on Thought Saver: https://florencehinder.substack.com/p/thought-saver-post-mortem
- Which mountain are you climbing?: https://florencehinder.substack.com/p/local-maximum-vs-global-maximum
